```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
#library
```{r}
library(Seurat)
  library(GSVA)
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
```
#input file
```{r}
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

Tumor_dge <- read.csv(
  "Tumor_dge_results.csv"
)

FT_dge <- read.csv(
  "FT_dge_results.csv"
)

correlation_Object_CD8 <- readRDS("correlation_Object_CD8.rds")
shared_seurat_obj <- subset(correlation_Object_CD8, subset = FT_top50Tumor_share == "Shared_with_FT")

published_signatures2 <- read_excel("science.abl5447_table_s4.xlsx", sheet = 2)
```
#function
```{r}
run_ssgsea_correlation <- function(seurat_obj, geneset1, geneset2, analysis_name, out_dir = "results") {
  expr_data <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", slot = "data"))

  geneset1 <- unique(na.omit(intersect(geneset1, rownames(expr_data))))
  geneset2 <- unique(na.omit(intersect(geneset2, rownames(expr_data))))

  if (length(geneset1) < 2 || length(geneset2) < 2) {
    stop(paste0("Not enough overlapping genes for ", analysis_name))
  }

  genesets <- list(geneset1 = geneset1, geneset2 = geneset2)
  gsva_results <- GSVA::gsva(expr_data, genesets, method = "ssgsea")
  gsva_scores <- as.data.frame(t(gsva_results))

  correlation <- cor(gsva_scores$geneset1, gsva_scores$geneset2, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  png(file.path(out_dir, paste0(analysis_name, "_ssgsea_correlation.png")), width = 1800, height = 1500, res = 200)
  plot(
    gsva_scores$geneset1, gsva_scores$geneset2,
    xlab = "Score of geneset1",
    ylab = "Score of geneset2",
    pch = 19, col = "blue",
    main = analysis_name
  )
  abline(lm(gsva_scores$geneset2 ~ gsva_scores$geneset1), col = "red", lwd = 2)
  text(
    x = min(gsva_scores$geneset1, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(gsva_scores$geneset2, na.rm = TRUE),
    labels = paste0("Correlation: ", round(correlation, 2)),
    pos = 4, col = "red"
  )
  dev.off()

  write.csv(
    data.frame(
      analysis = analysis_name,
      correlation = correlation,
      n_geneset1 = length(geneset1),
      n_geneset2 = length(geneset2)
    ),
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(analysis_name, "_summary.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  invisible(list(
    correlation = correlation,
    gsva_scores = gsva_scores,
    geneset1 = geneset1,
    geneset2 = geneset2
  ))
}
```
#Tumor signature versus FT signature
```{r}
geneset_Tumor <- Tumor_dge$gene
geneset_FT <- FT_dge$gene

run_ssgsea_correlation(
  seurat_obj = correlation_Object_CD8,
  geneset1 = geneset_Tumor,
  geneset2 = geneset_FT,
  analysis_name = "all_CD8_Tumor_vs_FT"
)

run_ssgsea_correlation(
  seurat_obj = shared_seurat_obj,
  geneset1 = geneset_Tumor,
  geneset2 = geneset_FT,
  analysis_name = "shared_CD8_Tumor_vs_FT"
)
```

#FT shared data versus NeoTCR8
```{r}
geneset_NeoTCR8 <- na.omit(published_signatures2$NeoTCR8)

shared_seurat_obj_FT <- subset(shared_seurat_obj, subset = sample == "FT")

run_ssgsea_correlation(
  seurat_obj = shared_seurat_obj_FT,
  geneset1 = geneset_NeoTCR8,
  geneset2 = FT_dge$gene,
  analysis_name = "FT_shared_NeoTCR8_vs_FT_DGE"
)
```

#Tumor shared data versus NeoTCR8
```{r}
shared_seurat_obj_Tumor <- subset(shared_seurat_obj, subset = sample == "Tumor")

run_ssgsea_correlation(
  seurat_obj = shared_seurat_obj_Tumor,
  geneset1 = geneset_NeoTCR8,
  geneset2 = Tumor_dge$gene,
  analysis_name = "Tumor_shared_NeoTCR8_vs_Tumor_DGE"
)
```
